transition.name: Audio Mix
transition.description: Crossfades the audio between two adjacent clips on the same track
transition.author: Dan Dennedy

parameter.name: start
Crossfade Curve
parameter.comment:
Constant Gain (linear) fades both clips at a constant rate, which can produce a noticeable volume dip at the midpoint.
Constant Power (equal power) uses cosine/sine curves so the perceived loudness stays constant through the crossfade — generally recommended for music and dialogue.
